reviews.text: We were new to Barcelona and needed someone to watch our dog for 5-6 hours, since our dog is still adjusting to the new city. Dog Care Barcelona accommodated our late request and arranged a caretaker in 3 days notice. We even got to meet the caretaker and introduced our dog the day before the service. We appreciate the help!
A great experience! The dogs had a wonderful time, and Ruy sent us updates and photos the whole time. Thanks! 🔝 …

An absolute 5-star experience! The facility is wonderful, and the staff is incredibly polite and professional. They handled a minor misunderstanding caused by me with such grace and kindness. My dog came back happy and full of energy. Highly recommended!
We had an amazing experience; they were a huge help with our dog during an emergency, and we'll definitely use them again. Aida took such good care of our dog ♥️

This is the second time I've left my dog ​​with Dog Care, and the experience was excellent once again. Communication with the caregiver was direct and very smooth at all times. I also received constant updates on how my dog ​​was doing, which was very reassuring, and the service was very friendly and personalized. Thank you so much! I will definitely use them again.

A wonderful, professional, and attentive service. They were always in contact with me, sending photos and videos of my dogs. Paulina, the caregiver, was very affectionate with them, and my dogs were very happy in her company! We will definitely use them again. Thank you so much!

A perfect 10/10 experience! I left my 14-year-old dog with them for a few days and she couldn't have been happier. You can really see the love and dedication they have for the animals—she didn't want to leave when I went to pick her up! It's so reassuring to leave her with a family where she's treated like family and where she enjoys being with other furry friends. Highly recommended!
Everything was great! The communication with the team, the matching with the sitter and the experience during our holidays. Our dog was well taken cared and we received pictures every day!

We are so happy with the care Poncho and Cookie received. From the very first moment, they were incredibly attentive, responsible, and communicative, keeping us updated on how our two furry friends were doing and sending us photos and videos regularly, which gave us so much peace of mind.

Furthermore, during our trip, we had an unexpected change of plans due to surgery, and we greatly appreciated their understanding, availability, and flexibility in adapting to the situation and staying with them for the extra time needed.

Poncho and Cookie were very well cared for, and we felt supported and at ease at all times. We would definitely use their services again and highly recommend them.

Unfortunately, I had a very disappointing experience with this dog-sitting service.

I had provided information about my dog’s needs and temperament beforehand, including that he can be reactive around other dogs, particularly male dogs, that he is 12 years old, and that he does not do well being left alone for long periods. I’m not sure where the communication broke down, but the care I arrived to was very different from what I had expected: there were two other dogs staying there, including an intact male, and the introduction was immediately very tense and clearly not a good fit for my dog.

There was also some confusing communication around the timing. I was initially told that the sitter would be away at the gym for about an hour in the evening, but this later seemed to become a much longer period during which my dog would be left with the other dogs. I left him despite already having a very uneasy feeling about the situation.

I did receive one photo shortly afterwards where he looked happy, which reassured me somewhat. However, I received no further update that evening. When I picked him up at 9:30 the following morning, I was told that he had refused food, did not want to be touched, did not want to go for a walk that morning, had vomited three times the previous evening, and had spent much of his time outside on the terrace because he was uncomfortable. I was shocked to hear this.

What I find concerning is that nobody contacted me when he vomited three times. I completely understand that dogs can vomit sometimes and not every small issue requires an immediate call, but three times combined with refusing food and behaving like this is something I absolutely would have expected to be informed about, especially when I was only a message away. I was even told that they had been worried about him. If they were worried, I don’t understand why I was not contacted.

There was also a steep staircase that I had warned about on arrival, as my dog has previously had back problems and cannot safely manage situations like that on his own. Despite this, he ended up falling down the stairs.

After I picked him up, there was no follow-up to ask how he was doing, despite having told me they had been concerned about him. The only thing I received afterwards was a few photos from the main account, including a video of another dog that wasn’t even mine, followed by a simple “Bye Miko.”

Another detail that I found quite bizarre was being asked when I picked him up whether my dog was a female. He is a male dog, and I had provided his information beforehand.

Overall, I was extremely disappointed by the lack of communication, attention to the information provided, and consideration of my dog’s individual needs. He came home clearly having had a very stressful experience, and in hindsight I believe he would have been better off staying alone in a hotel room than going through this situation.

I understand that dogs can behave unexpectedly and not every stay will go perfectly. What I cannot accept is a lack of communication when a dog is visibly unwell or distressed. I would not feel comfortable booking their service again.

Update: The company has publicly responded to this review claiming that this booking did not take place through their company. This is incorrect. I booked the service directly through this company and have the complete WhatsApp conversation, including communication with their account+ the sitter before and after the booking and photos of my dog sent by them during the stay. I deliberately did not name the individual sitter in my review, as I wanted to review the service rather than publicly single out one person. I find it quite concerning that my experience is now being publicly denied rather than addressed.

They took great care of my dog, always attentive, sending me photos and responding to every message instantly. The girl who looked after my dog ​​was also very kind and clearly loves pets. Everything was great, thank you! 😉 👍🏻

Excellent service! I had an unexpected trip and trusted this company to care for my pet (Alana). The service was fantastic; they kept us informed the whole time, and the assigned caregiver, Anabella, was wonderful. Alana was always in good hands. 😊
Replied really fast and were very helpful and friendly!

I'm very happy with the services from Dog Care Barcelona. They cared for my dog ​​and cat like they were part of their own family, and I will definitely use their services again. Thank you so much for making me feel at ease knowing my babies were in good hands :)
Excellent service! I was always kept informed about my furry friend! 💯 Highly recommended!!
Very professional, excellent communication. We're a bit of a handful and they made us feel very comfortable and at ease!

Excellent service. Our dog sitter was very attentive (despite the language barrier) and readily available. He was incredibly kind and affectionate with my sweet little girl.
The people who manage everything were very understanding of my fears and my dog's needs. A wonderful experience. Thank you so much!
Ron has been very well looked after on his walks, and we are very calm.
Very professional and caring with our dog. Fernanda, a kiss from Donete.

I highly recommend them. My dog ​​was treated extremely well, I received several photos every day, I was in constant contact with them, and they always responded quickly. Top-quality service. You can travel with peace of mind, knowing your dog will be in excellent hands with them.

The best thing about the service is that it's personalized to your dog's needs; Valentino was very happy with his caregiver, and we received photos frequently to let us know how he was doing. We would do it again a thousand times over, thank you so much for everything! ❤️
I left my dog ​​with them for 5 days and it was great! They sent me photos every day of how everything was going and I'm so happy!

200% Recommended!!! Excellent professionalism, friendly service, and of course, our dogs were in the best hands (they send photos and videos throughout the day, keeping you updated on how your pet is doing).
Thank you, Alejandro, because even though we didn't know each other, you gave me a lot of confidence from the very first moment, and the caregiver you assigned, Alexander, was fantastic...very attentive and affectionate with Roma.
Without a doubt, if I have to spend the summer in Barcelona, ​​I'll be back!!
THANK YOU SO MUCH
Great service. Great communication. My dog was clearly content while I was away. Fair pricing. Will definitely use again in the future.
Very happy with them and especially with Alexander who took great care of our furry friend, with lots of love and attention; he is also very methodical and disciplined.
My dog Charlie had the best time, he was cared for and loved as if he was their own dog and I got more updates than I could even look at. He’ll definitely be back!!

We used the daycare service for our dog, Nacho, and the experience was outstanding from start to finish. Communication with Alejandro was excellent right from the beginning. He patiently answered my countless questions and found the perfect caregiver for Nacho during our stay in Barcelona.

Nacho immediately liked Alexander, his daytime caregiver, and happily went with him without any hesitation. Throughout the day, we received plenty of photos and videos, which gave me complete peace of mind while exploring Barcelona. I knew Nacho was having a great time and was being well cared for.

We couldn’t have made a better choice! I wholeheartedly recommend this service. We will definitely come back the next time we visit Spain. In my opinion, the price is very reasonable and offers excellent value for the quality of care.
The service and attention were excellent. I will definitely be back.

The whole experience was amazing! Milka is not used to being alone too often so it was assigned a caregiver with that special need! We received multiple updates throughout the day for the whole time Milka was away and made us feel so relaxed and safe to know she was happy! Definitely recommend!! Thank Dog Care Barcelona 🤍🤍🤍 …

The service was amazing! Everyone was so sweet and friendly. I was worried that doggy might be stressed the first few days, but I was so surprised to see him so calm, eating the food they gave him. I couldn't be happier every time they sent me new photos of my dog! The service left no doubt that everything would be great. Thank you on behalf of Archie and me. 🥹😍

very irresponsible. I would never leave my pet with them. Disorganized and rude. There is NO attention to the client or the pet, considering my terrible experience with them I’m starting to think that the good reviews are fake.

Dog Care offers a very good service. Angie, the caregiver, is a wonderful person and very affectionate with my dog. They sent us videos and photos daily, which gave me peace of mind.
Thank you so much for everything, see you next time!

We had the privilege of experiencing Dog Care Barcelona with Angie and Lugo, and we couldn't be happier with the professional and impeccable service they provided to us and our Dachshund. We also want to thank Dog Care Barcelona for their excellent service from the very beginning and for making everything so easy. It was our first time leaving our dog outside the family home, and we would definitely return if the opportunity arises. We are grateful to the entire Dog Care Barcelona team, and especially to Angie and Lugo, who were responsible for taking such good care of our dog and making this a truly positive experience.

I left my dog ​​Roxy with Dog Care for 5 nights and the experience was excellent. They sent me photos and videos every day, which gave me great peace of mind while I was away.

I especially want to thank her assigned caregiver, Giomara, because it's clear she treated Roxy with so much love, affection, and dedication. Roxy was very well cared for and happy.

Thank you so much to the whole team. 🧸
Great service in the heart of Barcelona. All three of the walkers we had clearly love dogs and looked after my 11 year old Weimaraner very well

The guys and Alexander looked after our dog Sammy for over a week as we went back to the UK and we couldn’t have asked for better carers! We got SO many updates of our dog during the day which so nice when we’re in a new country! HIGHLY recommend thank you guys!!
Unprofessional and irresponsible.

I booked a service and ended up canceling because of how they handled the situation.

My concerns were minimized, they tried several times to convince me to accept conditions I wasn't comfortable with, and when I decided not to book, the problem shifted to my dog.

Trust is fundamental when you leave your dog in someone's hands. In my case, they completely lost it.

Luckily, I found another option that inspired confidence from the very first minute. The difference was enormous.

If a dog center that works with dogs can't understand the potential danger of an unneutered dog with an unspayed female dog… I really don't know if they're responsible enough or knowledgeable enough to care for dogs. Extremely unprofessional, rude, and incapable of handling situations with care. I could post screenshots and show you how uneducated and rude they are. But I won't go that low.
Excellent service and quality. They treated me very well and were very understanding with my puppy. Thank you so much.

Thank you so much for taking such good care of Frankie. It's clear you do your job with love, dedication, and professionalism. We felt so reassured knowing he was in such good hands.

We also want to congratulate you on the excellent service you provide. The attention, communication, and care of the dogs are truly exceptional. Throughout his stay, we constantly received photos and videos of our dog 🐶. We will definitely use your services again and recommend you to others.

I'd never left my dog ​​with anyone other than a friend or family member, so I was a little anxious, but my dog ​​was great with Paola ❤️ She loves animals and gave me complete peace of mind. I also loved that she sent me tons of photos and videos without me even asking. I'll definitely be back. Thank you so much!

Fernanda took great care of our goldendoodle Taro! I was so worried but she kept us updated always, sending photos, videos and updates. Taro didn’t even want to come home after her 4 nights stay. Thank you Fernanda and Dog Care BCN team, would recommend them :)
We had a wonderful experience with Dog Care Barcelona. The company and the host were very communicative. Our dog had a fun time and we were able to enjoy our day! We would use this service again.

I've never used such a great daycare service! The whole team, the communication, everything was perfect! Kunai came back super happy and well-balanced, which is what I look for most when I have to hire caregivers for a long period of time! Thanks to Nico and Ari especially for all the information they provided and for treating my daughter so well! 🩷
Excellent treatment and service. They took great care of Max. Definitely 100% recommended.

I contacted Dog Care because I urgently needed to leave my dog ​​overnight, and from the very first moment, they gave me a quick and clear solution.

The whole process was very easy, and leaving Pichi with Ari and Nicola gave us complete peace of mind. They kept us updated with photos and videos throughout her stay, and you could see the care and love they gave her ❤️🐶
I wholeheartedly recommend them. A huge thank you to Dog Care and especially to Ari and Nicola for taking such good care of Pichi.

An excellent experience. My husband and I were nervous about leaving our dog, more so than we ever had been before. But Dog Care Barcelona managed everything perfectly, sending us photos throughout the process and making us feel very safe. Alexandra was wonderful every step of the way, and our dog loved her! 100% recommended
The process was easy and the service was perfect. Hanim (our dog) loved the host (beautiful Paola) very much .

Delighted with Dog Care's services! I left my 5-month-old puppy with Paola, a very attentive and caring woman who took wonderful care of Chucky during the day. She sent us photos and videos so we could rest assured knowing he was well looked after. Chucky was happy and calm when we picked him up. I will definitely use them again when we return to Barcelona!

The perfect company to take care of your pet. At first, I was quite scared and unsure, but they made the right choice with the people who looked after my dog ​​(Ari and Nico), and I'm incredibly satisfied. It was my first time, and it was well worth it. I'm so grateful for the care my dog ​​received and the constant communication! Thank you so much!

Highly recommended experience. We left our two dogs with them as we were going on vacation. At the last minute, we had to bring the return date forward by one day, and they didn't give us any trouble at all. Professional and in contact every day.

This is the first time I've used this type of service, as my dog ​​is very attached to me and tends to be wary of strangers. However, with this professional team, I'm very happy and at ease. Alexander took excellent care of her and completely won her trust. They sent me photos and updates about her constantly, so I was completely calm and reassured knowing she was in good hands.

Thank you!

We left our French bulldog, Lola, with Fernanda for four days, and the experience was wonderful. Fernanda took such good care of her, and it's clear she loves dogs.

They sent us photos and kept us updated every day, which was very reassuring. Lola came back very happy.

We definitely recommend them; 100% recommended. Thank you so much for taking such good care of our dog!

We had an excellent experience with DogCare Barcelona this Easter week. We booked their boarding service with Ari and Nico, and honestly, Moli, our dog, couldn't have been happier! They took such good care of her! Lots of walks, playtime, and lots of love! They even sent me photos and videos. We had complete peace of mind knowing she was doing well! We'll definitely be back! Thank you so much for a fantastic job!
Everything was great!
My dog ​​was very happy and well cared for. They kept me informed the whole time. I highly recommend them.
Great, and thank you Alexander for Sonic!

They were wonderful during our trip; it was the first time we'd ever entrusted our dog to someone else, and they made us feel so at ease. They were both professional and very friendly. They will always hold a special place in our hearts.
They kept sending me photos, which made me feel much more at ease knowing my dog ​​was in good hands. Very happy with the service, we'll definitely be back!

Fantastic! We can only say good things 🤗
We had a trip and two days before leaving we were left without someone to leave our dog with. In addition, our little one is not an easy dog ​​since we adopted her two months ago and she has suffered abuse. Since we contacted them everything was super easy and efficient. We were able to see the facilities before leaving her and during the trip we were receiving daily photos and videos of how she was and that reassured us a lot. They gave us confidence and security. We will definitely repeat❤️‍🩹
The caretaker, Alexander, was very helpful and my dog ​​was so happy when we picked him up. 10/10 recommended!!!
We'll definitely be back! They send photos, they're very friendly, and my dog ​​came home very happy. Thank you so much!

The experience couldn't have been better.
Galway basically fell in love with Fernanda, her caregiver—I'd say she even forgot she had owners.

I received photos and updates constantly, like, "Look, Mom, I'm living my best life."

And we... total peace. We almost felt guilty about how happy she was.

So yes, of course: we're going to call her again.

Thank you, Dog Care Barcelona, ​​for all the care and for impeccable communication.
You made our lives so much easier.
